reader.requirement: For a sequential file at --std 85 the compiler must accept ACCESS [MODE] [IS] SEQUENTIAL, treat the omitted clause as sequential (VII.2.4.3 GR1), and refuse RANDOM and DYNAMIC, which the Sequential I-O format does not print, whether ORGANIZATION SEQUENTIAL is written or omitted.
reader.edition-search: BindFileControl's sequential-file screen (COBOL1858, `file.IsSequential && file.AccessMode is Random or Dynamic`) has no edition predicate and is documented edition-invariant; grep of FileControlBinder.cs for DialectLevel|Year found only the PADDING gate; accessMode grammar has no predicate; SEQUENTIAL/RANDOM/DYNAMIC reserved at all editions.
reader.witnesses-cover: part: the pb692 witnesses cover RANDOM/DYNAMIC refusal with ORGANIZATION written and omitted; the optional MODE/IS words with SEQUENTIAL and the omitted-clause default are not exercised

probes.printed: W 00 / R 00 AAAA / R 00 BBBB / EOF / R 10 / R3 AAAA (exit 0; ACCESS MODE IS SEQUENTIAL, ACCESS SEQUENTIAL, clause omitted)
probes.expected: all accepted; records read in write order, AT END status 10

probes.printed: COBOL1858 file 'F1': ACCESS MODE IS RANDOM may not be specified for a sequential file; COBOL1858 file 'F2': ACCESS MODE IS DYNAMIC ... ORGANIZATION clause being omitted
probes.expected: both refused: VII.2.4.2 prints only SEQUENTIAL

citations.check: OK  §1985:VII.2.4.2  (2.4.2 General Format)  the text is in the clause
OK  §1985:VII.2.4.1  (2.4.1 Function)  the text is in the clause
OK  §1985:VII.2.4.3 GR1  (2.4.3 General Rules)  the text is in GR1

reader.notes: The shared accessMode grammar admits three words; the sequential restriction is the edition-invariant entry screen in BindFileControl, keyed on FileModel.IsSequential so the omitted ORGANIZATION clause is covered. The refusal message cites §2023:12.4.5.5.2 SR2 at --std 85 (cosmetic).
reader.at-2023: sq2bad gives the same two COBOL1858 refusals at --std 2023

refuter.evidence: sx1bad.cob (b,c): ACCESS MODE IS SEQUENTIAL RELATIVE KEY IS RK on a sequential file (ORGANIZATION omitted) refused COBOL0863; ACCESS written twice refused COBOL2423; an earlier version with 'ACCESS MODE IS.' refused COBOL5506 (expected DYNAMIC, RANDOM or SEQUENTIAL). sx2.cob (e): ACCESS SEQUENTIAL written before ORGANIZATION SEQUENTIAL accepted; the file used in SORT USING and a MODE IS SEQUENTIAL file in GIVING sorts CCCC/AAAA/BBBB to AAAA,BBBB; OPEN EXTEND appends (status 00, last record DDDD). cite.py: OK §1985:VII.2.4.3 GR1 (the text is in GR1).
